name: go-modern-guidelines
description: Help AI coding agents write modern Go
one_liner: A cheat-sheet file that teaches AI coding assistants to write up-to-date, idiomatic Go instead of outdated patterns.
buyer: Honestly nobody pays for this directly — it's a free configuration file for Go teams using AI coding tools.
business_use_cases: A Go shop drops this into its AI assistant's config so generated code automatically matches current team standards.
A coding-agent vendor bundles similar per-language guideline packs as a selling point for enterprise plans.

money_ideas.idea: Write and sell similar 'modern language guidelines' packs for languages this project hasn't covered, as an add-on for AI coding tools.

steal_this: Write the same style guide for a language JetBrains hasn't covered yet (modern Rust or Kotlin) and give it away to build an audience.
